programme.desc: A travel programme from a fresh perspective that visits shrines famous nationwide for offering "gori-yaku" blessings, unravels the form those blessings take, and introduces their history and local culture.

programme.title: The Laughing Salesman
programme.desc: 1989 — Based on the horror manga created by duo Fujiko Fujio, The Laughing Salesman tells the story of a salesman named Moguro Fukuzo, whose job is to help people fill gaps in their soul. However, in reality, he ruins people's lives if his clients backstab him or never ask him for help.

programme.title: A Hundred Scenic Views of Hometown Japan
programme.desc: 2022 — The beautiful face of Japan changes dramatically with the turning of the seasons. We visit the original landscapes of home that still remain in the middle of the city.

programme.title: Glass Mask
programme.desc: 2005 — Her father passed away very early and her mother lives and works in a crowded Chinese restaurant. Kitajima Maya, a 13-year old girl, has to carry the burden of making ends meet as she fights against her ill fate. However, she is able to overcome the trials and tribulations in her life with her passion and enthusiasm. She happens to encounter the reclusive actress Tsukikage who decides to train and mould her into the foremost actress of her generation.

programme.title: NG Knight Lamune & 40
programme.desc: 1990 — Baba Lamune, a 4th grader, is pulled into another world after he beats a video game he bought from a street peddler. He arrives in Hara-Hara to discover he's destined to save the world from the evil Don Harumage, with the help of the Guardian Knights, free-thinking robots. In 2008 it became one of over thirty titles transferred from ADV Films to FUNimation, the main distributor of anime in the English speaking world.

In this small town, partly because of his late father's character, the head priest's duties were not limited to officiating Buddhist ceremonies; he also had to deal with a wide range of problems, from a counseling desk for all manner of worries to welfare-related work. His boss ordered him to go to the North Africa and win the competition, and they can control the great mineral resources of Africa. He hired the best mercenary in Africa whose name is Lauder and a former general Kabbah to help him. Yan has discovered their conspiracy, he is the only one who can stop them.

Fueled with vengeance, he leads us on an action packed thrill ride while avenging his friend's death.

programme.title: My Sweet Home
programme.desc: 2026 — Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), a housewife whose children are already independent, lives a rich, peaceful life with her husband. She has a close circle of friends bound by deep friendship. Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa — each has a different home and profession, but now they regularly get together, with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And one other friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... They had always been together since their student days as "Shunka Shuto." Then one day comes the sudden news of Fuyumi's death. As the three think back on Fuyumi and on how they have lived their own lives honestly and never strayed from the path, they begin to reconsider who they have been up to now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach 60. "Just once, I want to become someone other than myself." The three remember the wish Fuyumi spoke of while she was still alive. And so they decide to try a foolish idea that the Fuyumi in heaven would probably laugh at: a two-week "trial life" swapping partners with one another.

The King’s Face
programme.desc: 2014 — Since Kwanghae was born from a concubine and only appointed as Crown Prince in a desperate measure, many dissatisfied officials from Northerner faction often plotted for his assassination and dethronement for 16 years. He also often quarreled with his father, King Seonjo, especially regarding Kim Ga Hee. Both son and father will fight against each other in favor of her. However, he eventually managed to overcome the obstacles by the help of Physiognomist, Kim Do Chi and become the next king. Meanwhile, Gwiin Kim is King Seonjo’s royal concubine.

programme.title: My Sweet Home
programme.desc: 2026 — Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), a housewife whose children are already independent, lives a rich, peaceful life with her husband. She has a close circle of friends bound by deep friendship. Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa — each has a different home and profession, but now they regularly get together, with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And one other friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... They had always been together since their student days as "Shunka Shuto." Then one day comes the sudden news of Fuyumi's death. As the three think back on Fuyumi and on how they have lived their own lives honestly and never strayed from the path, they begin to reconsider who they have been up to now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach 60. "Just once, I want to become someone other than myself." The three remember the wish Fuyumi spoke of while she was still alive. And so they decide to try a foolish idea that the Fuyumi in heaven would probably laugh at: a two-week "trial life" swapping partners with one another.

programme.title: Anpanman
programme.sub-title: 'Baikinman and Soft Serve Man' and others
programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this cheerful urban drama portrays the life of Ittetsu Tanonaka, an ordinary young man who had been working in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, suddenly being forced to serve as the head priest at a temple after his father's unexpected death. Although he had received basic training to become a head priest, it was a tremendous challenge for a young man who had been living carefree in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating from college. In this small town, partly because of his late father's character, the head priest's duties were not limited to officiating Buddhist ceremonies; he also had to deal with a wide range of problems, from a counseling desk for all manner of worries to welfare-related work. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn in two. With encouragement from his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this heartwarming downtown family drama brightly depicts his growth into a proper head priest. (26 episodes total)

programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this cheerful urban drama portrays the life of Ittetsu Tanonaka, an ordinary young man who had been working in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, suddenly being forced to serve as the head priest at a temple after his father's unexpected death. Although he had received basic training to become a head priest, it was a tremendous challenge for a young man who had been living carefree in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating from college. In this small town, partly because of his late father's character, the head priest's duties were not limited to officiating Buddhist ceremonies; he also had to deal with a wide range of problems, from a counseling desk for all manner of worries to welfare-related work. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn in two. With encouragement from his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this heartwarming downtown family drama brightly depicts his growth into a proper head priest. (26 episodes total)

programme.title: Kiss That Kills
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2018 — A mysterious woman appears in front of Otaro Dojima. The mysterious woman has a pale face with red lips. She kisses him and he dies, but the next moment he regains consciousness. He realizes he is now seven days in the past. The mysterious woman also follows him. Due to her kiss, Otaro Dojima dies and goes back to the past over and over again.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this cheerful urban drama portrays the life of Ittetsu Tanonaka, an ordinary young man who had been working in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, suddenly being forced to serve as the head priest at a temple after his father's unexpected death. Although he had received basic training to become a head priest, it was a tremendous challenge for a young man who had been living carefree in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating from college. In this small town, partly because of his late father's character, the head priest's duties were not limited to officiating Buddhist ceremonies; he also had to deal with a wide range of problems, from a counseling desk for all manner of worries to welfare-related work. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn in two. With encouragement from his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this heartwarming downtown family drama brightly depicts his growth into a proper head priest. (26 episodes total)

programme.desc: 2014 — This is the second installment of “pub poet” Rui Yoshida's travels in Hokkaido! Following “Port Town Walks in Hokkaido with Rui Yoshida ,” this series will take you to every corner of Hokkaido, from mountain towns surrounded by nature to inland towns and remote islands, accompanied by female announcers from HBC. They also have a lot of fun with store owners and regular customers! In search of Hokkaido's hidden gems, seasonal delicacies, sake, and encounters, Rui Yoshida's wandering journey continues.

However, the secret of his daughter, Akiko's birth, is hidden in convoluted web of lies and agony.

However, the secret of his daughter, Akiko's birth, is hidden in convoluted web of lies and agony.

programme.title: 2026 Sumitomo Mitsui VISA Taiheiyo Masters Golf
Quiz Derby
programme.desc: A quiz show that emphasizes the entertainment value of a horse-race style format, in which the contestants are likened to racehorses and bet their own points on the contestant they think is most likely to answer correctly, relying on reasoning and intuition. The questions asked each time are varied, ranging from general knowledge to ones packed with gags. The three teams of two contestants each bet, in units of at least 100 points, from their 3,000 points based on the host's arbitrary odds assigned to the five contestants. The outcome is determined by whether they choose to keep betting steadily on Hara Taira, who has low odds but a high correct-answer rate, or the "Queen of Three Choices" Keiko Takeshita, or instead go for a big payoff by betting on contestants like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, who have high odds but not such a high correct-answer rate. With the winner unknown until the very end, contestants receive prize money equal to their points.

programme.desc: 2026 — The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

programme.title: Aibou
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Legendary Head: Sho
programme.desc: 2024 — Ijuuin Shou is the leader of the Grand Cross, a gang of delinquents with over a thousand members. Yamada Tatsuhito is a perennial errand boy with no presence in class who is the bottom of the school hierarchy. When Shou ends up hospitalized, he proposes that Tatsuhito take his place as his body double for a month while he recovers to prevent the gang falling into disarray. Tatsuhito, who goes from a life of being bullied to a life as a delinquent leader, struggles to get through each day without others finding out his true identity. Takahashi Fumiya takes on a dual role of both characters.

programme.title: Trick of the Jidai Police
programme.desc: 2006 — Shūichirō Kiriyama works at the Limitation Task Force, the place where the cases which have reached the statute of limitations are destroyed. Getting bored of his job, he decides to find a hobby, because it seems important to him to have a hobby. So he decides to puzzle out the unsolved cases on his free time, helped by his coworker Mikazuki, who seems to have a crush on him.

programme.title: The Woman of S.R.I. (1999)
programme.desc: 1999 — Mariko is a forensic scientist working at the Kyoto PD Crime Lab. Her credo is “science never lies” and she delves into the truth of the case with her colleagues with their specialized skills and knowledge in forensic medicine, physics, chemistry etc. Mariko’s steadfast belief in science makes her stand against conventional institutional ethics of the police department, diehard detectives averse to scientific investigation and sometimes even with her own colleagues, but she stays faithful to her belief in science and continues to pursue the truth.

programme.title: Aibou
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: The Man Who Won't Divorce - The Deceitful Love of a Cheated Husband and an Evil Wife
programme.desc: 2024 — Okatani Wataru, who was an ace reporter in the social affairs department of a major newspaper company, witnesses his wife having an affair and decides to get a divorce. Although he makes steady preparations to gain custody of his daughter, a talented lawyer he consults with tells him that his chance of winning is only 10%. Instead of going ahead with the divorce right away, he works hard with his partner, a detective, to gather evidence of his wife’s affair in order to earn the right to be the rightful caretaker of his daughter.

programme.title: Hot Stove League
programme.desc: 2026 — The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse. Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. programme.title: Aibou
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

programme.title: Gurame! The Premier Minister's Chef
programme.desc: 2016 — The heroine is the Prime Minister’s Chef, a post revived after 70 years since the Yoshida Cabinet. A 25 year old female chef, Kurumi Ichiki is appointed to the post skipping over veteran chefs for her extraordinary talent. programme.desc: 2005 — An I-turn to the countryside you've longed for. A U-turn to your beloved hometown. A new challenge after turning 50... We introduce the way of life of people who found their own "paradise of life" and are living a fulfilling second life, along with beautiful scenery and delicious food. People working hard to revitalize their hometowns, people who fulfilled a long-held dream by opening a shop, people enjoying a leisurely "country time" in the midst of nature. Everyone's idea of happiness is different, but while introducing various second lives, this is a "program for discovering the path to a good life" that proposes new ways of living.

Trick
programme.desc: ★ 7.2/10 · 2000 — Although 23 year old Yamada Naoko is a "super" magician, she is continously fired and constantly hounded by her landlady for the rent being late. After being fired once again, her boss shows her an ad of a physics professor, a non-believer of all things magical, offering money to anyone who can prove to him that magic is real. Desperately needing the money, Naoko accepts the challenge, which is how she comes to meet Professor Ueda. Falling prey to her simple magic tricks, Ueda is impressed, and enlists Naoko to help him uncover the tricks behind a local cult. Their hilarious antics, along with those of police officer Yabe, leads them onto further mysteries, all with tricks needing to be solved in sort of an "X-Files" meets "Scooby-Doo"...

programme.title: Discovering Houses with Atsushi Watanabe
programme.desc: 1989 — “Watanabe Atsushi no Tatemono Tanhō” was planned in the spring of 1989 as a travel program to visit renowned buildings across Japan, starting in Okinawa and moving north with the cherry blossom front. It was supposed to end after three months... but before long it became popular and, before anyone knew it, one of Japan's longest-running programs. Its focus also gradually shifted from public buildings to homes, and today it has become a program devoted to houses. And so, searching for wonderful homes, Watanabe Atsushi's “journey” continues today.

programme.desc: 2016 — The First Investigative Division is the star unit of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. Jun'ichi Ōiwa, the head of the division, leads around 400 elite detectives. He has an extremely heavy responsibility: attends initial investigations at the scenes of all brutal crimes that occur within the metropolis, decides on the course of action of the investigations at the same time as he directs many investigation task forces and gets into investigations himself at the critical phase. However, Ōiwa is definitely not a superman. Amid his suffering, Ōiwa overcomes this grave responsibility and is quite simply a "life-size hero" and "ideal boss" to his subordinates.

If Only Someone Were There
programme.sub-title: A masterpiece medical drama starring Yuji Oda and Ken Ishiguro, with a screenplay by Koki Mitani
programme.desc: 1993 — This is a story of two physicians who are complete opposites. Although he's a skilled surgeon, Dr. Shiba does not believe that every life is worth saving, but is willing to perform any surgery for the right price. On the other hand, Dr. Ishikawa is an idealist who believes that doctors should treat all patients equally and fight to protect every person's right to live. Therefore, Ishikawa quickly becomes liked by hospital staff while Shiba continues to make enemies.

Therefore, Ishikawa quickly becomes liked by hospital staff while Shiba continues to make enemies.

programme.title: Drama
programme.desc: 1982 — This is the first directorial work by the newcomer Kobayashi, who made his debut the same year in a supporting dual role in Umbrella. However, after filming several indoor scenes, production was halted due to various circumstances, and the film was never released publicly, making it a lost work. It has been skillfully edited by Mr. Mouri into a coherent piece. It allows us to glimpse the origins of Kobayashi’s lifelong study of romance films. One is captivated by its exquisite lighting and camera work.

programme.title: Seicho Matsumoto 20th Anniversary Special Project Series: "The Mayor Dies" - A hidden masterpiece filmed for the first time in 53 years
programme.desc: 2012 — The mayor is found dead in the river in a small town known for its hot springs. It's assumed that he fell to his death, but his nephew just cannot understand why his uncle would have gone there by himself to begin with. When he cleans up his house, he finds his uncle's diary and tries to find out what exactly happened.

programme.title: Seicho Matsumoto 20th Anniversary Special: "Suspicion" - Tokiwa Takako and Ono Machiko co-star in their first collaboration
programme.desc: 2019 — Sahara Takako is a lawyer who specialises in civil cases. She hates to lose and will use whatever means necessary to pursue the truth. Despite her competence, she is mocked as a rotten lawyer for defending companies that exploit their employees and winning many of these lawsuits. One day, Takako gets an unexpected request from a veteran lawyer, Harayama Masao. He would like her to take over the defence of a woman because he is in poor health and needs to be hospitalised. This woman is Shirakawa Kumako, who has been in the public eye. Called “Onikuma” by the public, which is a play on her maiden name, Onizuka, she faces charges of killing her husband Fukutaro, the owner of an established Atami restaurant, for insurance money.

To uncover these "hidden treasures," Udo-chan, the "travel and gourmet master," visits long-established kappo restaurants... Visiting various famous establishments such as local izakayas, casual diners, and popular ramen shops. She savors exquisite gourmet food to the fullest. Udo-chan travels between Iwate and Tono. After strolling through the land of kappa legends, I was moved by the warm broth of Tohoku local dishes at a restaurant in Denjoen. At a long-established wagashi shop, I enjoyed famous sweets. Next, I savor spicy thin noodles at a popular ramen shop filled with the owner's dedication from learning about local ramen techniques. programme.title: Noodle Train ~A Gourmet Rail Journey of Noodles~: Taiwan Railway
programme.desc: Railway-loving celebrities introduce various lines and the charms of the lines while enjoying station noodles in 'Mentetsu ~Men-Eating Railway: A Spectacular Journey~.' This time, it's the show's first overseas edition—a noodle-eating journey around Taiwan! Rokkaku rides the west side, Ichikawa tours the east side by train, and they savor Taiwan's proud noodle dishes and railway culture! ◆ Western Main Line... Episodes< Longitudinal Line (north to south section), Taichung Line (mountain line) > Performers: Seiji Rokkaku departs from Keelung, a port town in northern Taiwan. First, at the night market, they enjoy rice noodles called Ding Bian Suo (Ding Bien Suo) with seafood-flavored soup. The next day, visit a museum in Taipei to see the steam locomotive that ran during the Japanese colonial era. The rice vermicelli I had in Hsinchu, northern Taiwan, was different from Japanese rice noodles, with a firm texture and a special garlic soy sauce that was truly appetizing. At Changhua Station, Rokkaku toured the only remaining operating roundhouse in Taiwan, and was thrilled by the variety of old and new trains and the many railway fans just like in Japan. The next day, he boarded a trolley train once operated by a sugar factory. Tainan's famous eel yakisoba was an addictive dish with a proteiny, light texture and a flavor reminiscent of Japanese Worcestershire sauce. For the finale, we headed to Kaohsiung while enjoying the retro appearance and facilities of the Chuguang Express (express train), which is disappearing from Taiwan. ◆ Pingtung Line: South Ring Line Eastern Main Line < Taitung Line Northern Ring Line Yilan Line > Pingxi Line Western Line (Northern Section) Featuring Saya Ichikawa On the other hand, Mr. Ichikawa explores Kaohsiung at night by subway and tram. After enjoying the famous Formosa Island Station, one of the world's most beautiful stations, he enjoys sweet bean paste noodles topped with fried mackerel and grilled rice at the night market. The next day, he heads north from Kaohsiung eastward and boards the Lanpi Jieyou train from Fangliao Station. In Taitung, he is fascinated by rice noodles, made by grinding steamed rice. At the unique Yilan Station, where a realistic giraffe statue is combined with the station building, you can't help but take continuous photos with your camera. At Shifen Station, famous for crowds crowding right up to the train tracks, you can experience the custom of writing wishes on lanterns and releasing them into the sky. At the final destination, Taipei, we visited a beef noodle shop run by Japanese people. We uncovered the secret behind its popularity that long lines form even before opening. See more

programme.title: The Secrets of Weekend Travel: Being a Couple Isn’t That Simple
programme.desc: 2023 — An overwhelming sense of "travel sentiment," "scenery," and "travel" — a new-style travel drama that re-examines what it means to be a "couple" through travel! My spouse and I both work, and we are both true professionals. It's been about 10 years since we got married, and on weekdays we barely have time to talk or see each other. On holidays, we both do... Sometimes it's golf, sometimes we're tired... But we live together in the same space. Half a year ago, I made a suggestion to my husband. That was to go on a "weekend trip for two." Of course, the purpose is to heal from weekday fatigue, but once we travel, we stay together forever, whether we want to or not. "Anything is fine. Let's honestly talk about what we think about each other" was the main reason. My husband agreed easily. In our 10th year of marriage, my husband and I began our "weekend trip together." See more

To sell out CDs that were once huge hits but still sold out in large quantities, the two set out on a business trip to the local areas with just a suitcase. programme.title: Noodle Train ~A Gourmet Rail Journey of Noodles~: Taiwan Railway
programme.desc: Railway-loving celebrities introduce various lines and the charms of the lines while enjoying station noodles in 'Mentetsu ~Men-Eating Railway: A Spectacular Journey~.' This time, it's the show's first overseas edition—a noodle-eating journey around Taiwan! Rokkaku rides the west side, Ichikawa tours the east side by train, and they savor Taiwan's proud noodle dishes and railway culture! ◆ Western Main Line... Episodes< Longitudinal Line (north to south section), Taichung Line (mountain line) > Performers: Seiji Rokkaku departs from Keelung, a port town in northern Taiwan. First, at the night market, they enjoy rice noodles called Ding Bian Suo (Ding Bien Suo) with seafood-flavored soup. The next day, visit a museum in Taipei to see the steam locomotive that ran during the Japanese colonial era. The rice vermicelli I had in Hsinchu, northern Taiwan, was different from Japanese rice noodles, with a firm texture and a special garlic soy sauce that was truly appetizing. At Changhua Station, Rokkaku toured the only remaining operating roundhouse in Taiwan, and was thrilled by the variety of old and new trains and the many railway fans just like in Japan. The next day, he boarded a trolley train once operated by a sugar factory. Tainan's famous eel yakisoba was an addictive dish with a proteiny, light texture and a flavor reminiscent of Japanese Worcestershire sauce. For the finale, we headed to Kaohsiung while enjoying the retro appearance and facilities of the Chuguang Express (express train), which is disappearing from Taiwan. ◆ Pingtung Line: South Ring Line Eastern Main Line < Taitung Line Northern Ring Line Yilan Line > Pingxi Line Western Line (Northern Section) Featuring Saya Ichikawa On the other hand, Mr. Ichikawa explores Kaohsiung at night by subway and tram. After enjoying the famous Formosa Island Station, one of the world's most beautiful stations, he enjoys sweet bean paste noodles topped with fried mackerel and grilled rice at the night market. The next day, he heads north from Kaohsiung eastward and boards the Lanpi Jieyou train from Fangliao Station. In Taitung, he is fascinated by rice noodles, made by grinding steamed rice. At the unique Yilan Station, where a realistic giraffe statue is combined with the station building, you can't help but take continuous photos with your camera. At Shifen Station, famous for crowds crowding right up to the train tracks, you can experience the custom of writing wishes on lanterns and releasing them into the sky. At the final destination, Taipei, we visited a beef noodle shop run by Japanese people. We uncovered the secret behind its popularity that long lines form even before opening. See more

programme.title: Reiwa Suspense Theater: Traveler Coroner Dōjō Shūsaku
programme.desc: A classic travel suspense story told with a completely original story! On a journey across Japan, he uncovers the truth behind unpredictable incidents! Shusaku Dojo, a former metropolitan police coroner played by Takeshi Naito, travels with a notebook left by his late wife when he unexpectedly gets caught up in a case. He decides not to get involved in the investigation... But with his sharp perspective as a former coroner, he guides the case to a solution. Shusaku Dojo (Takeshi Naito), a retired former metropolitan police coroner, sets out on a journey to a place associated with haiku beloved by his late wife. Using his wife's notebook, he visits Yamagata Prefecture, which is associated with haiku poets like Basho Matsuo. There, he meets Saori Yoshizaki (Shinobu Nakayama), a university lecturer in classical literature, and they hit it off. The next day, when they go hiking, the two discover a hanged body. As detective Yoshio Shibasaki (Jundai Yamada) and his team rush to the scene, Dojo unconsciously observes the body as a former coroner and gives a piece of advice to forensic officer Shohei Kashiwagi (Jingi Irie) present. And that one comment from Dojo triggers a major case to take center stage. A haiku collection is found in a body bag, and a massive project led by Yoichiro Mizumoto (Kazuhiko Kanayama), head of Yamagata's leading company Mizumoto Corporation, and his wife Akiyo (Jun Shibuki)... Dojo, a retired former coroner, refuses to get involved in the investigation but approaches the truth behind the murder case with a sharp perspective. When the dots connect, Dojo learns a shocking truth... Hidden there was a dramatic story that could not be told without tears. See more

programme.title: Drinking Around Kyoto with the Old Guys
programme.desc: 2022 — Takuzo Kakuno, who loves Kyoto, and Yoshimasa Kondo, who moved to Kyoto, are two unique actors who travel around Kyoto in search of delicious drinks and snacks! Takuzo Kadono, a Kyoto enthusiast, spends over 60 days a year in Kyoto. Meanwhile, Yoshimasa Kondo has been living in Kyoto since 2020 after getting married. The unique personalities captivated by Kyoto... What if two cool actors go drinking and strolling!? --- so, a new kind of gourmet entertainment show featuring older men set in Kyoto! From popular spots with hard-to-book reservations to hidden gems and casual izakayas--- they introduce a variety of restaurants across all genres and teach the way of Kyoto drinking. This time, special guests join the duo of Takuzo Kakuno & Yoshimasa Kondo. First, we gathered at a popular café. Apparently, the person Kakuno called over was... An old acquaintance, actor Sato B. The three first went to Higashiyama in Shimizuzaka, a famous tourist spot. After looking up at Yasaka's tower--- the three of us tried pottery together. While receiving instruction from the young kiln owner, the three of us happily turned the potter's wheel. Since these three were handcrafting, of course, sake vessels! Each of their personalities was revealed during the process--- and the look of the result was something to look forward to watching the show! After enjoying the recently popular "Kyoto Chinese Cuisine," which could be called a boom, we headed to Kondo's favorite izakaya. Surprisingly, the person wearing an apron at the counter was?? This time, the three of us enjoyed Kyoto's sake and snacks lively and enjoyed a day of an adult excursion. Please enjoy a leisurely drink together! See more

programme.title: Falling in Love with Hawaii!
programme.desc: 2018 — Navigate the real Hawaii! You're sure to fall in love with Hawaii too!! Makoto Ryo Uchino, a local girl who has been traveling between Hawaii and Japan for over 30 years, and Sasha, a local girl, deliver deep Hawaii information not found in guidebooks! Sightseeing spots, gourmet food, shoppike... With so much content for both beginners and Hawaii lovers! From the moment you watch this show, you'll surely fall in love with Hawaii! When you think of Hawaii, it's famous for poke rice bowls made with fresh tuna and Instagram-worthy treats! Fluffy pancakes. Plus, there are various classic gourmet dishes like hearty loco moco! This time, Hawaii Koi focused on the "Asai Bowl," a breakfast you definitely want to eat when you come to Hawaii. Hawaii's most traditional magazine, Honolulu Magazine, apparently decides the Best Acai Bowl Award every year through reader votes. This time, Makoto and Sasha introduce the top "Acai Bowl" restaurants that won the top spot in 2022 and 2023. Find the "Acai Bowl" you want to eat this summer! See more

programme.title: Falling in Love with Hawaii!
programme.desc: 2018 — Navigating the real Hawaii! You're sure to fall in love with Hawaii too!! Makoto-chan, also known as Ryo Uchino, and local girl Sasha, who have been traveling between Hawaii and Japan for over 30 years, deliver deep Hawaii information not found in guidebooks! Sightseeing spots, gourmet food, shops... With plenty of content for both beginners and Hawaii lovers! From the moment you watch this program, you'll surely fall in love with Hawaii! Essential hotel information for your Hawaii trip! Until now, Makoto and Sasha have visited resort hotels that have undergone major renovations and were revitalized, but this time, we introduce the adults-only hotel, Roamer House Waikiki. The hotel concept is inspired by old-fashioned Hawaii, with a nostalgic place where adults can take a break and pay special attention to the interior. The restaurant also features an "izakaya" style that is not intimidating, opening as a community space where adults can casually gather. Furthermore, while the hotel usually has a pool, this hotel has a "hot tub" instead of a pool, allowing adults to relax and unwind from their daily fatigue. Be sure to check it out next time you visit Hawaii. See more

programme.title: Udo-chan's Gourmet Kingdom: Japan
programme.desc: Japan, a treasure trove of gourmet food! "Travel and gourmet master" Udo-chan savors exquisite gourmet foods from all over Japan! Japan, a treasure trove of gourmet food! However, there are still many little-known gourmet foods lying quiet all over Japan. To uncover these "hidden treasures," Udo-chan, the "travel and gourmet master," visits long-established kappo restaurants... In the third installment, Dojo—played by Tsuyoshi Naito—again becomes embroiled in an unexpected case while traveling to places connected to his late wife. The setting this time is Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, a hot spring resort loved by poet Akiko Yosano. After reuniting with his former Metropolitan Police colleague Kazuto Kubo (Hirotake Murata), Dojo is deeply moved as memories of his wife come back to him. But his encounter with Chiran tea farmer Naho Hidaka (Naomi Zaizen) pulls him back into the case. A mysterious body found in a lake, a rights battle over a traditional “taste,” a suspicious fall accident from ten years ago, a mother and child growing apart after the father’s death... The dots connect, and the shocking truth hidden behind the case comes to light. More

programme.desc: A classic travel suspense drama told through a completely original story! While traveling around Japan, he gets to the truth of an unforeseeable case! Shusaku Dojo, a former Metropolitan Police medical examiner played by Takashi Naito, travels with a notebook left behind by his late wife and unexpectedly gets caught up in a case. Though he tries to stay out of the investigation, his sharp eye as a former examiner leads the case toward resolution. Former Metropolitan Police medical examiner Shusaku Dojo, played by Takashi Naito, sets out on a journey again to a place connected to his late wife. This time, the setting is Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture, a place associated with the world-renowned printmaker Shiko Munakata. Dojo Shusaku (Takashi Naito), a former Metropolitan Police medical examiner, takes part in a bus tour his late wife had signed up for while she was alive. Along with guide Toko Sakai (Maki Mizuno), a university professor, and a travel magazine reporter among the participants, he enjoys a peaceful trip through the town of sculptures, Inami, and the World Heritage site Gokayama. But… On the way, they discover an unidentified body and once again become embroiled in a case. The group stays at a remote hot spring inn accessible only by boat. However, bad weather traps them there. The identity of the unidentified body, the suspicious traffic accident from six years ago, a woman who vanished at the isolated inn… Dojo, who is asked by local police officer Ryosuke Sakuma (Yuki Ogoe) for help, tries not to get involved in the investigation, but gradually moves closer to the heart of the case. More

programme.title: Drinking Around Kyoto with the Old Guys
programme.desc: 2022 — With Kyoto lover Takuzo Kadono and Yoshimasa Kondo, who moved to Kyoto, two distinctive actors go bar-hopping through Kyoto in search of great drinks and snacks! Takuzo Kadono, a "Kyoto expert," stays in Kyoto more than 60 days a year. Meanwhile, Yoshimasa Kondo has been living in Kyoto since 2020, after getting married. What happens when these two distinctive actors, both charmed by Kyoto, go out drinking? -- That said, this is a new-style gourmet entertainment program about middle-aged men set in Kyoto! From popular restaurants that are hard to reserve to hidden gems known only to insiders, to izakaya to drop into at random -- we introduce a wide variety of shops regardless of cuisine, while teaching the proper way to enjoy Kyoto drinking. This time we start on the Eiden panoramic train "Kirara"! Enjoying the summer vacation of middle-aged men. First, they head to Kibune, where the temperature is said to be 10 degrees lower than in Kyoto city. After visiting Kibune Shrine, the head shrine of water deities with around 2,000 affiliated shrines nationwide, they enjoy their first-ever kibune kawadoko meal. Mesmerized by the open, refreshing scenery, the men are smitten. Next, they return to the city for a noryo-yuka on the Kamo River. They will enjoy a hot pot dish loved by Sakamoto Ryoma. What kind of drink pairs with such a flavorful pot? Finally, the men head to Gion, where they are most at ease. Their summer day comes to a very satisfying end at a stylish Japanese-style bar. More

programme.title: Falling in Love with Hawaii!
programme.desc: 2018 — Navigate real Hawaii! You’re sure to fall in love with Hawaii too!! Makoto-chan, also known as Ryo Uchino, who has spent over 30 years living back and forth between Hawaii and Japan, and local girl Sasha bring you deep Hawaii information that isn’t in guidebooks! Packed with sightseeing spots, gourmet food, shopping, and more, this is for both Hawaii beginners and Hawaii lovers alike! The moment you watch this show, you’re sure to fall in love with Hawaii! Souvenirs are essential for any Hawaii trip. Find a favorite item for friends, family, and yourself too. A great recommendation for that is the hotel "signature shop." It’s a treasure trove of exclusive items that will keep the excitement going. This time, Makoto-chan and Sasha introduce plenty of limited-edition goods from hotel shops they recommend. First, the shop at the oldest hotel in Waikiki, the Moana Surfrider. Most of its products are exclusive items you can only buy there. We also introduce the shop at the Kahala Hotel, which is celebrating its 60th anniversary. A shop has opened at the Royal Hawaiian Center where you can now buy items that used to be available only at the Kahala Hotel. Be sure to check out souvenirs for your next purchase! More

programme.title: Falling in Love with Hawaii!
programme.desc: 2018 — Navigate real Hawaii! You’re sure to fall in love with Hawaii too!! Makoto-chan, also known as Ryo Uchino, who has spent over 30 years living back and forth between Hawaii and Japan, and local girl Sasha bring you deep Hawaii information that isn’t in guidebooks! Packed with sightseeing spots, gourmet food, shopping, and more, this is for both Hawaii beginners and Hawaii lovers alike! The moment you watch this show, you’re sure to fall in love with Hawaii! Coffee is a famous Hawaiian specialty and a popular souvenir. Kona coffee from the Big Island is very well known, but did you know there’s also delicious coffee on Oahu? This time, we’ve come to the North Shore in northern Oahu. A sacred place for surfing and a popular spot where you can enjoy all kinds of Hawaiian food, the North Shore is also home to the town of Waialua, in the northwest, where you can savor delicious coffee. Long ago sugarcane was the main industry, but today coffee production is thriving there. In this episode, a must for coffee lovers, we experience a popular factory tour where anyone can join, from cultivation of original coffee and chocolate to tasting! More
